status.summary: Former UFC light heavyweight title challenger (lost a unanimous decision to Jon Jones at UFC 247, Feb 8, 2020, scored 48-47, 48-47, 49-46, and a KO to Jan Blachowicz for the vacant title at UFC 253). After four straight losses from 2020 to 2022 and a 19-month layoff, he is 5-1 since June 2024. Most recently he took a split decision over Johnny Walker at UFC 327 (Apr 11, 2026) and knocked out Azamat Murzakanov in round 1 at UFC 333 (Oct 24, 2026, Abu Dhabi), per the ufcstats snapshot. His only loss in that run is a first-round KO by Carlos Ulberg at UFC Perth (Sep 27, 2025). No next bout or current ranking was confirmed for this file.

signature: first-round knockouts with punches at distance (Jacoby R1 2:00 with two knockdowns, Krylov R1 2:24, Murzakanov R1 2:40)

low kicks in volume when the fight goes long (12/15 leg strikes in round 3 vs Walker; 25/27 vs Ovince Saint Preux)

weaknesses: four KO/TKO losses: Blachowicz (2020), Prochazka by spinning back elbow (2021), Ryan Spann in round 1 (2022), Ulberg in round 1 (2025)
2.9 knockdowns absorbed per 100 head strikes taken (decayed), more than twice the light heavyweight league rate of 1.3
low output in long fights: 8.2 significant attempts per minute decayed, and Walker out-landed him 42-34 (29/38 to the legs) in the split-decision win
little offensive wrestling (0.09 takedowns per 15 min decayed)
style.summary: A tall southpaw with real one-punch power: seven of his eleven UFC wins are KO/TKO, six of them in round 1, and he knocks opponents down at more than twice the division rate per head strike. He mixes in body work and low kicks and finishes on top when he can, but a fragile chin (four KO losses) makes every exchange high-risk.

moves.notes: Southpaw: 'cross' is his straight left, 'jab' his right, 'hook' a lead right hook. Each group sums to 1; the engine's target split picks the group. Decayed sums in fighters.json: significant attempts 71% head, 14% body, 15% legs; landed 63% head, 16% body, 21% legs (head accuracy 0.51, legs 0.82); career landed body share 24%. No scouting source was gathered on his punch selection, so the head weights are a generic southpaw-power profile with the rear straight on top. Body kicks lead the body group on the Jones fight (48/55 body landed, mostly at distance). Leg kicks split evenly for lack of a source on the target. Clinch strikes are 6% of decayed attempts, so knee and elbow are small; ground work shows up as ground-and-pound, not elbows specifically. No spinning techniques recorded. Sources: data/derived/fighters.json; ufcstats per-fight totals in data/raw.

appearance.build: tall and broad-shouldered with a muscular frame; 6 ft 4 in with a 77 in reach (ufcstats)

engine_notes.note: Power: 2.7 knockdowns per 100 significant head strikes landed (decayed), 2.4 career, against a light heavyweight league rate of 1.3; the highest of this group.

Chin: 2.9 knockdowns absorbed per 100 head strikes taken (decayed), 1.9 career; 4 knockdowns absorbed and 4 KO/TKO losses in 16 UFC fights. He is hit less than most (2.9 absorbed per minute decayed), but what lands hurts him.
Takedown defense 91% decayed and 83% career; control against him is 26 s per 15 min decayed, far below the 154 s light heavyweight league rate.
In 5-round fights his landed rate relative to round 1 runs 1.00, 1.20, 1.29, 0.65, 1.05 (minute-weighted; only the Jones fight reached rounds 3-5, so those three values are one fight).
Against Walker his output rose late and switched to the legs: 10, 9 and 15 significant strikes landed by round, with 12 of 15 leg strikes in round 3.
